title: Duplicate ServiceNow incidents from the phone channel
scenario: Larkspur's Service Desk sees pairs of identical incidents for the same call, a few seconds apart, worse in the mornings. Integration on-call blames Connect invoking the Lambda twice and wants a ServiceNow rule that deletes duplicates. You own the create-incident Lambda; the bundle has Lambda logs, flow logs, the ServiceNow export, transaction times and request timings.
task: Prove the duplicate mechanism from logs, export and timings; rule the double-invocation theory in or out
Make incident creation idempotent per contact, including ambiguous failures, re-invokes and races
Keep the flat string map contract and the flow's time budget
acceptance: Commit-then-504 and timeouts produce exactly one incident and return its number
Re-invokes and concurrent invocations create one incident
DynamoDB claim is a conditional put with TTL
Root cause with evidence in ANSWER.md
